title: Apple WWDC 2005-The Intel Switch Revealed
summary: Steve Jobs's WWDC 2005 keynote segment announcing Apple's move from PowerPC to Intel processors, and revealing that Mac OS X had been secretly built for Intel all along.
why: Cited in threads about Apple's chip transitions as the primary source for the Intel switch announcement and the secret x86 builds.

quote.text: Apple had been building OS X on x86 for five years prior to announce of the last shift.
